name: Ore Abundance
summary: Caves and mountains in newly explored land hold half as many ore veins again, so mining trips pay off sooner.
logoPrompt: A single chunk of stone block cracked open with large glowing veins of diamond, gold, redstone and emerald ore, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Half as many ore veins again.

description: **Ore Abundance puts more ore veins into the Overworld, so a mining trip fills your chests a little faster without making ores feel cheap.**
- About 1.5 times as many veins of coal, copper, iron, gold, redstone, lapis lazuli, diamond and emerald.
- Veins keep their usual size, height and biomes: diamonds stay deep, emeralds stay in the mountains.
- The extra gold of badlands, the large copper veins of dripstone caves and the large diamond veins grow too.
Pick the zip under Data Packs when you create a new world, or put it into the `datapacks` folder of an existing world and open the world again. Then go mining in land you have not visited yet.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3.
- Only affects newly generated chunks. Land you have already visited keeps its ores.
- Nether ores stay as they are. Because it changes world generation, Minecraft may show its "experimental settings" notice when you open the world.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
